title: Minimum of a rotated sorted array
summary: A staircase was cut and its pieces swapped; find the lowest step by comparing the middle step with the last one.
goal: Find the lowest step of the cut-and-swapped staircase

mapping.story: The drop where the cut was

examples.label: Not rotated
examples.explanation: With no cut, the first step is lowest.

ladder.name: Look at every step
ladder.idea: Walk the whole staircase and keep the lowest step.

ladder.name: Compare the middle with the last step
ladder.idea: If the middle step is higher than the last step, the drop is to its right; otherwise the lowest step is the middle or to its left. Halve and repeat.
ladder.insight: The last step tells us which side of the cut the middle is on: the part after the cut is entirely lower than the part before it.

transfer.problem: A circular list of times sorted from earliest but starting somewhere in the middle: find the earliest time quickly.
transfer.explanation: It is a rotated sorted list; comparing the middle with the end tells you which half holds the start.

selfCheck: Compares the middle with the last element of the range, not the first.
Keeps the middle when it might be the minimum (high = mid).
Works when the array is not rotated.

aka: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
